messages.content: What parameters do the viscous friction force depend on, and in which case should it be taken into account for the physical pendulum model? In your response the last word of each sentence must become the first word of the next sentence.

message.content: The viscous friction force depends on the velocity of motion. Motion occurs when the pendulum swings through a fluid medium. Medium resistance is proportional to the speed and size of the object. Object dimensions determine the drag coefficient in this calculation. Calculation accuracy requires including damping for low-speed oscillations. Oscillations dampen significantly without accounting for air resistance. Resistance models are essential for predicting real-world decay rates. Rates of energy loss vary with the viscosity of the surrounding fluid. Fluid properties must be measured precisely for valid simulations. Simulations reveal how quickly the amplitude decreases over time. Time evolution shows the transition from free damped motion to rest.
